en.title: David Harbour Teases Robert Downey Jr.'s 'Really Special' Return in Avengers: Doomsday

en.body:
The MCU faithful are eagerly awaiting the return of some of their most beloved heroes in **Avengers: Doomsday**, and **David Harbour** is adding fuel to the fire with his glowing praise for co-star **Robert Downey Jr.** Harbour, who is set to reprise his role as the stoic Red Guardian, recently shared his thoughts on Downey Jr.'s much-anticipated comeback, describing the performance as "really special."

This sentiment from Harbour underscores the immense creative energy surrounding **Avengers: Doomsday**. With an ensemble cast that reads like a who's who of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, featuring names like **Chris Evans**, **Chris Hemsworth**, **Pedro Pascal**, and **Florence Pugh**, the film is poised to be a cinematic event of epic proportions. Harbour's specific commendation for Downey Jr., who famously originated the role of Tony Stark/Iron Man, suggests a narrative arc that deeply honors the character's legacy and impact on the franchise.

## Red Guardian's Cosmic Return

**David Harbour**'s journey as Alexei Shostakov, the Red Guardian, has been a unique one within the MCU. Introduced with a blend of gravitas and surprising humor, the character has become a fan favorite. His return in **Avengers: Doomsday** promises to further explore his place within the sprawling cosmic narrative. While details about his specific storyline remain under wraps, Harbour's involvement alongside such a powerhouse cast is a significant draw for viewers who have followed the MCU's intricate storytelling.

## What Fans Are Saying

News of Harbour's comments has sent ripples of excitement through the online fan community. Many are speculating about the nature of Downey Jr.'s role, given that his character, Tony Stark, had a definitive end in **Avengers: Endgame**. Harbour's description of the performance as "really special" suggests that Downey Jr. might be appearing in a capacity that transcends a simple cameo, potentially through flashbacks, alternate timelines, or even a form of digital resurrection that Marvel is known to explore. The sheer scale of the reported cast for **Avengers: Doomsday** has fans convinced this will be a culmination of years of storytelling, and Harbour's insights provide a tantalizing hint of the quality of performances to expect.

## What's Next

While **Avengers: Doomsday** is slated for a December release, **David Harbour** also has another high-profile project on the horizon: a new Netflix show reuniting him with **Millie Bobby Brown**. Details on that series are still emerging, but fans can look forward to seeing Harbour back in action on both the big and small screens.
